hooks.command: jq -r .tool_input.command | grep -Eq 'terraform[[:space:]]+(apply|destroy)|-auto-approve' && { echo 'Blocked: terraform apply and destroy are human-only' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -r .tool_input.command | grep -Eq 'terraform[[:space:]]+apply' && grep -q 'Overall Status: FAIL' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reports/latest-report.txt" && { echo 'Blocked: latest drift report is FAIL, review reports/latest-report.txt before any terraform apply' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
